Pacific Biosciences Of California Inc (NASDAQ:PACB) Institutional Investors Q2 2018 Sentiment
November 25, 2018 - By Adrian Erickson Sentiment for Pacific Biosciences Of California Inc (NASDAQ:PACB)
Pacific Biosciences Of California Inc (NASDAQ:PACB) institutional sentiment decreased to 1.34 in 2018 Q2 . Its down -0.59, from 1.93 in 2018Q1. The ratio worsened, as 43 investment managers opened new and increased holdings, while 32 sold and trimmed holdings in Pacific Biosciences Of California Inc. The investment managers in our partner’s database reported: 85.41 million shares, down from 88.24 million shares in 2018Q1. Also, the number of investment managers holding Pacific Biosciences Of California Inc in their top 10 holdings was flat from 2 to 2 for the same number . Pacific Biosciences of California, Inc. designs, develops, and makes sequencing systems to resolve genetically complex problems. The company has market cap of $1.12 billion. The companyÂ’s single molecule real-time sequencing technology enables single molecule real-time detection of biological processes. It currently has negative earnings. It offers PacBio RS II and Sequel Systems that conducts, monitors, and analyzes biochemical sequencing reactions.
